name: Ronnie Taylor
source:
Creative director. Extravagant and dramatic. Each season will change his hair color to the pantome of the year. He becomes extremely nervous in the execution of the projects and cries a lot. Movie lover, his favorite director is Wes Anderson.

"I can smell a new award!"
